subtitle: When Obedience Broke and Courage Burned Alone

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of a lone armoured rider before a distant sea of Mongol horsemen
panels.action: Zafar Khan sits rigid in the saddle, lance levelled, his face set with grim resolve as dust-darkened Mongol banners ripple on the horizon under a harsh Kili sun.

dialogue.text: In 1299, before Delhi’s walls, one commander defied his Sultan, charged the Mongol storm at Kili, and vanished in an ambush that still haunts the line between courage and command.

i18n.hi: १२९९ में, दिल्ली की दीवारों के आगे, एक सरदार ने अपने सुल्तान की न मानकर किली पर मंगोल तूफ़ान पर धावा बोला – और घात में गुम हो गया, जहाँ बहादुरी और हुक्म की रेखा आज भी कांपती है।

panels.shot: wide aerial shot of Delhi and its outskirts, with two armies encamped facing each other across open fields
panels.action: The fields near Kili stretch between the walled silhouette of Delhi and the sprawling tents of the Chagatai Mongols; Zafar Khan stands at the edge of the Delhi camp, studying the enemy lines in the dusty light.

dialogue.text: The Chagatai prince Qutlugh Khwaja rode down from the northwest with his Mongol host, and the earth near Kili trembled as Delhi’s fate hung on the choices of a few men.

i18n.hi: चगताई शहज़ादा कुतलुग़ ख़्वाजा उत्तर‑पश्चिम से अपने मंगोल लश्कर के साथ उतरा, और किली के पास ज़मीन थरथराई, क्योंकि दिल्ली की तक़दीर कुछ चंद मर्दों के फ़ैसले पर टंगी थी।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind Zafar Khan’s shoulder, framing distant Mongol riders wheeling in loose formation
panels.action: From behind Zafar Khan’s armored shoulder, the viewer sees Mongol horsemen practicing feigned retreats, their small horses kicking up rings of dust as they loose arrows at unseen targets.

dialogue.text: Amir Zafar Khan, hardened in Alauddin Khalji’s service, watched a foe famed for sudden storms and false flights, knowing that one misstep could open Delhi’s road.

i18n.hi: अमीर ज़फ़र ख़ाँ, अलाउद्दीन खिलजी की ख़िदमत में सख़्त हो चुका, उस दुश्मन को देख रहा था जो अचानक तूफ़ानों और झूठी पीछे हटने के लिए मशहूर था, जानता था कि एक ग़लती दिल्ली का रास्ता खोल सकती है।

panels.shot: intimate close-up on Zafar Khan’s face, half in shadow, eyes narrowed with strain
panels.action: Zafar Khan’s weathered face fills the frame, a faint scar at his jaw, sweat darkening his brow as he listens intently, the shadow of a tent wall falling across his eyes.

dialogue.text: The chronicler Barani would later name him among Alauddin’s foremost commanders, a man whose courage ran ahead of his caution, whose zeal the Sultan both used and feared.

i18n.hi: क़ाज़ी बरनी बाद में उसे अलाउद्दीन के बड़े सरदारों में गिनते हैं – जिसकी हिम्मत एहतियात से आगे भागती थी, जिसका जोश सुल्तान के काम भी आता था और डर भी।

panels.shot: broad tent interior shot, low-angle on Zafar Khan before an unseen superior, hands respectfully crossed
panels.action: Inside a spacious command tent, Zafar Khan stands stiff-backed before a raised central space where an unseen authority sits; his hands are folded in front, his jaw tight, as lamplight flickers on armour and carpets.

dialogue.text: On the Delhi side, orders were strict: hold the line, do not chase the Mongol wings, keep the army together. The Sultan’s command was clear, his suspicion of rash glory sharper still.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली की तरफ़ सख़्त हुक्म थे: क़तार न तोड़ो, मंगोल किनारों का पीछा मत करो, फौज को एकसाथ रखो। सुल्तान का फ़रमान साफ़ था, बेपरवाह शोहरत पर उसका शक और भी तेज़।

panels.shot: overhead tactical shot of Delhi’s line facing Mongol formations, with arrows arcing between them
panels.action: Seen from above, the Delhi infantry and cavalry stand in ordered ranks opposite the loose, shifting lines of Mongol horsemen; dark arcs of arrows rise and fall between them, and the gap of no-man’s-land is blurred with dust.

dialogue.text: At Kili, lines were drawn but battle did not explode at once. Skirmishes, probing attacks, arrows traded in the haze; each side searched for a weakness, a tilt in the balance.

i18n.hi: किली पर मोर्चे खिंचे, पर लड़ाई तुरंत नहीं भड़की। छोटे झड़पें, टटोलती टक्करें, धुंध में तीरों की अदला‑बदली; हर तरफ़ नज़रों से कमज़ोरी, झुकती तराज़ू की तलाश थी।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-wide of a Mongol wing wheeling away, with Delhi horse archers hesitating to pursue
panels.action: A Mongol wing turns in apparent retreat, riders glancing back as they ride off; Delhi horsemen in the foreground half-lean forward in their saddles, held back by the memory of strict commands.

dialogue.text: Khusrau and Barani both speak of the Mongol wings turning, of feigned flights and temptations laid. To chase meant disobedience. To hold meant letting the enemy choose the ground.

i18n.hi: ख़ुसरौ और बरनी दोनों मंगोल पंखों के मुड़ने, झूठी भाग और बिछाई गई लालच का ज़िक्र करते हैं। पीछा करना नाफ़रमानी था, थमना मतलब दुश्मन को मैदान चुनने देना।

panels.shot: medium shot of Zafar Khan swinging up into the saddle, subordinates around him reacting in alarm
panels.action: Zafar Khan swings into his saddle with a practiced motion, face burning with resolve, while nearby lieutenants reach out in alarm, some calling after him as his horse stamps impatiently.

dialogue.speaker: zafar_khan
dialogue.text: If no one breaks them, they will break us. Ride with me.

i18n.hi: "अगर हम उन्हें न तोड़ें, तो वो हमें तोड़ देंगे। मेरे साथ सवार हो।"

panels.shot: low-angle tracking shot of Zafar Khan’s cavalry detachment surging forward, leaving the main line behind
panels.action: Zafar Khan thunders ahead at the head of a compact cavalry detachment, faces grim, spears lowered, as behind them the ordered Delhi line recedes, officers gesturing helplessly amid billowing dust.

dialogue.text: Against orders, he broke from the main host. Barani names his detachment surging at a Mongol wing, courage unchained from command, as the straight line of Delhi’s army frayed behind him.

i18n.hi: हुक्म के ख़िलाफ़, वह अस्ल फौज से टूटकर निकल पड़ा। बरनी लिखते हैं कि उसका दस्ता मंगोल पंख पर चढ़ दौड़ा – हिम्मत कमान से आज़ाद, पीछे दिल्ली की सीधी क़तार बिखरती गई।

panels.shot: wide shot of Zafar Khan’s charge slamming into a Mongol wing, horses rearing, lances shattering
panels.action: In a chaos of dust and motion, Zafar Khan’s horse crashes into the Mongol front; lances splinter, riders lean and twist, and the line of impact ripples through men and mounts locking in close combat.

dialogue.text: The clash was fierce. Khusrau sings of Mongol ranks broken, of bodies falling and horses scattered as Zafar Khan’s charge struck like a hammer at the enemy’s flank.

i18n.hi: टक्कर भयानक थी। ख़ुसरौ गाते हैं कि मंगोल क़तारें टूटीं, लाशें गिरती रहीं, घोड़े तितर‑बितर हो गए, जब ज़फ़र ख़ाँ की टक्कर ने दुश्मन के पंख पर हथौड़े की तरह चोट की।

panels.shot: long shot showing Mongol ranks parting ahead of Zafar Khan, revealing open space as if inviting pursuit
panels.action: From a distance, Zafar Khan and his men push deeper as the Mongol line ahead parts, leaving an inviting corridor of trampled earth and fleeing riders that leads towards the hazy rear of the host.

dialogue.text: But the Mongols were masters of the baited path. Their front gave way, parting like a door, drawing Zafar Khan onward into what seemed a victory unfolding.

i18n.hi: पर मंगोल फँसाने वाले रास्तों के उस्ताद थे। उनका आगे वाला मोर्चा दरवाज़े की तरह अलग हुआ, ज़फ़र ख़ाँ को आगे खींचता, जैसे जीत सामने खुल रही हो।

panels.shot: sudden high-angle wide revealing Mongol forces closing in from multiple sides around Zafar Khan’s isolated detachment
panels.action: Seen from above, Zafar Khan’s small band rides into open ground when, from the flanks and rear, fresh Mongol units converge like tightening rings, their riders calm and deliberate.

dialogue.text: Barani and Khusrau both speak of what followed: a snare sprung. The Mongol wings folded back, encircling the isolated detachment in a planned ambush, the hunters now the trapped.

i18n.hi: बरनी और ख़ुसरौ दोनों आगे का मंजर लिखते हैं: जाल चरमराकर बंद हुआ। मंगोल पंख वापस लपके, अलग पड़े दस्ते को घेरे में लेते हुए – शिकारी ख़ुद फँस गए।

panels.shot: tight chaotic mid-shot inside the encirclement, Zafar Khan rallying his men as arrows fall around them
panels.action: Within the tightening circle, Zafar Khan turns in the saddle, sword raised high as his men cluster around, shields lifted while arrows thud into the ground and saddles around them.

dialogue.speaker: zafar_khan
dialogue.text: We stand together. No step back.

i18n.hi: "हम साथ खड़े हैं। एक क़दम पीछे नहीं।"

panels.shot: mid-shot of a Mongol officer gesturing toward Zafar Khan, offering terms as fighting pauses briefly around them
panels.action: In a brief lull, a Mongol officer on a dark horse raises an open hand towards Zafar Khan, his face composed; behind them, riders hold their distance, watching the exchange in tense silence.

dialogue.text: Barani preserves a stark moment: captured in the ring of steel, Zafar Khan was offered life and place among the Mongols if he would yield. Discipline had failed; his defiance had not.

i18n.hi: बरनी एक सख़्त लम्हा बचाते हैं: लोहे के घेरों में पकड़े गए ज़फ़र ख़ाँ को जान और मंगोलों में जगह की पेशकश हुई, अगर वह झुक जाए। तज़ीब टूट गई थी, मगर उसकी जुर्रत नहीं।

panels.shot: close-up profile of Zafar Khan on horseback, chin lifted, eyes hard, turning away from the Mongol envoy
panels.action: Zafar Khan sits straight, refusing to look fully at the Mongol envoy, his chin lifted and eyes blazing with a hard, inward resolve as he turns his horse back towards his outnumbered men.

dialogue.speaker: zafar_khan
dialogue.text: I was not forged to kneel. Do what you came to do.

i18n.hi: "मुझे घुटने टेकने के लिए नहीं गढ़ा गया। जो आया हो, पूरा कर।"

panels.shot: low, intimate shot of Zafar Khan dismounting to fight on foot amidst his surrounded men
panels.action: Dust swirls at knee height as Zafar Khan swings down from his horse, planting his feet firmly on the churned earth, sword in hand, while his men close ranks around him for a last stand.

dialogue.text: He refused. Barani’s words are stark: Zafar Khan would not submit, would not change sides. Surrounded, he chose to dismount and fight on foot until, as the chroniclers say, he fell where he stood.

i18n.hi: उसने इंकार किया। बरनी के शब्द सख़्त हैं: ज़फ़र ख़ाँ ने न सर झुकाया, न तरफ़ बदली। घिरा हुआ, उसने घोड़े से उतरकर पैदल लड़ना चुना, यहाँ तक कि, जैसा मुहर्रिख़ लिखते हैं, वहीं गिरा जहाँ खड़ा था।

panels.shot: somber wide shot showing the encirclement from afar, dust settling over a stilled battlefield pocket
panels.action: From a distant vantage, the once-roaring circle has stilled; scattered horses and dropped lances mark the spot where Zafar Khan’s band made its stand, Mongol riders slowly wheeling away through the fading dust.

dialogue.text: No Delhi banner rose from that ring again. Khusrau, Isami and Barani agree on this: Zafar Khan died fighting in the Mongol snare, his detachment broken with him far from the main host.

i18n.hi: उस घेरे से फिर कोई दिल्ली का झंडा न उठा। ख़ुसरौ, इसामी और बरनी इस पर एक हैं: ज़फ़र ख़ाँ मंगोल फंदे में लड़ते‑लड़ते मारा गया, उसका दस्ता भी उससे दूर, अस्ल फौज से कटा, टूट गया।

panels.shot: wide shot of the broader battlefield, Delhi and Mongol lines still facing, the sun lowering
panels.action: The wider field stretches out, both main armies still facing each other in wary lines under a lowering sun, as distant scavengers circle and faint smoke rises from scattered camps.

dialogue.text: Yet Delhi did not fall that day. The Mongols, too, bore wounds; modern historians note that Qutlugh Khwaja himself was gravely injured, and soon their host turned back from the city they had threatened.

i18n.hi: फिर भी उस दिन दिल्ली नहीं गिरी। मंगोल भी ज़ख़्मी हुए; आज के इतिहासकार लिखते हैं कि खुद कुतलुग़ ख़्वाजा बुरी तरह घायल हुआ, और कुछ ही देर में उनका लश्कर उस शहर से लौट गया जिसे वे डराने आए थे।

panels.shot: interior shot of a dim Delhi court hall, Alauddin’s silhouette on the throne, a tense hush in the air
panels.action: In the shadowed hall of Delhi’s court, the distant silhouette of Alauddin on his throne is framed against latticed light, courtiers standing stiff and silent along the walls, the absence of Zafar Khan palpable in the space.

dialogue.text: The chronicles do not speak of triumphal honours. Barani hints instead at a Sultan wary of commanders whose zeal outran obedience, and Zafar Khan’s name in the court record falls silent after Kili.

i18n.hi: तारीख़ें किसी बड़ी इज़्ज़त‑अफ़ज़ाई का ज़िक्र नहीं करतीं। बरनी इशारा करते हैं एक ऐसे सुल्तान की तरफ़ जो उन सरदारों से सहमा था जिनका जोश फ़रमान से आगे भाग जाता था – और दरबार के रिकार्ड में किली के बाद ज़फ़र ख़ाँ का नाम खामोश हो गया।

panels.shot: evocative medium shot of a weathered spear planted alone in the empty Kili field at dusk, with Zafar Khan’s ghostly silhouette suggested in the clouds
panels.action: At dusk over the quiet fields of Kili, a single rusted spear stands upright in the earth, while above, drifting clouds briefly suggest the faint outline of a rider gazing back toward distant Delhi.

dialogue.text: In Barani and Khusrau, Zafar Khan remains a paradox: a defender who struck hard at the Mongols yet shattered discipline, a man who chose death over surrender and left Delhi safer, but not because of his obedience.

i18n.hi: बरनी और ख़ुसरौ की किताबों में ज़फ़र ख़ाँ एक पहेली बना रहता है: मंगोलों पर सख़्त वार करने वाला मुस्तनद मुहाफ़िज़, पर साथ ही नसक तुड़वाने वाला – जिसने सरेंडर से बेहतर मौत चुनी, और दिल्ली को ज़्यादा महफ़ूज़ छोड़ा, पर फ़रमान निभाकर नहीं।

panels.shot: slow push-in on an imagined stone carving of Zafar Khan, one hand on sword, the other empty, set into a crumbling wall
panels.action: An imagined stone relief of Zafar Khan is carved into an aged wall, one hand resting on his sword and the other open and empty, as small plants grow in the cracks and the stone is worn by time.

dialogue.text: His last charge at Kili leaves a lingering question for every age: when the enemy presses and orders hold you back, is heroism the courage to break free, or the harder strength to stand still together?

i18n.hi: किली पर उसका आख़िरी धावा हर दौर के लिए एक सवाल छोड़ जाता है: जब दुश्मन धकेल रहा हो और हुक्म तुम्हें रोकते हों, तो असल वीरता फ़रमान तोड़कर टूट पड़ने में है, या साथ मिलकर थमे रहने की सख़्त ताक़त में?

title_i18n.en: Zafar Khan's Last Charge at Kili

subtitle_i18n.en: When Obedience Broke and Courage Burned Alone
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब फ़रमान टूटा, हौसला अकेला जला
